soup-group.txt.title: Introducing Soup-Group: A 'Soup' of Cooperative Agents
soup-group.txt.content: Recently, we've been working on a new invention: soup-group. It's a Cooperative Review System with Intelligent Delegation that uses a 'Divide & Conquer' strategy to optimize token usage by ~90%. With a role-based architecture (Manager and Workers) and Human-in-the-Loop support, it's designed to make document reviews faster and smarter. Check it out at: https://codeberg.org/iPoe/soup-group
